Did the sun sing a song as it colored the sky?
Did the waves makes a song as they crashed to the shore?
Or was it the whales?
Or the lions' first ROAR?
Did the first flowers hum as they burst into bloom?
Or was the first song when the thunder went BOOM?
Maybe elephants running load over the ground ...
Or maybe the birds made the first singing sound.
All these guesses we've made are quite good, but they're wrong.
It was God, our Maker, who sang the first song!
When God made the earth, He decided to sing, And He wrote His song into everything.

Ellie Anderson

About the author

Ellie Anderson writes practical, compassionate guides for people who want healthier relationships without feeling overwhelmed or judged. Her work centers on communication, emotional awareness, and rebuilding trust—both with others and with yourself. Her approach is grounded and realistic, blending evidence-informed insight with clear, everyday language that readers can actually use. She believes meaningful change doesn’t come from dramatic breakthroughs, but from small, consistent shifts that help people feel steadier, clearer, and more confident in how they relate. Through her books, Ellie helps readers better understand their patterns, strengthen emotional boundaries, and build skills that translate into real life—not just reflection. Outside of writing, Ellie is closely involved in creating thoughtful, educational resources focused on personal growth and emotional well-being. She values quiet mornings, long walks, and well-worn notebooks filled with ideas in progress—many of which eventually find their way onto the page.
